body:
closes #30258

## Problem

`nvim_del_keymap()`, `nvim_buf_del_keymap()` and `vim.keymap.del()` match a
mapping by its `{rhs}` as well as its `{lhs}` in a two-round scan if no detected mapping is found.

 so deleting one `{lhs}` can wipe an unrelated mapping. that contradicts the documented removal by `{lhs}`.

## Solution

as clason suggested, just change the lua api contract. namely, route the API unmap path through the existing `MAPTYPE_UNMAP_LHS` so only `{lhs}` is matched

leave `:unmap` alone for compatibility.
